issues.detail: The Greek 'τους ιδιους δεσποτας' (their own masters) is rendered as 'coi chủ mình' (consider their own masters). The Greek text does not contain a verb of perception or cognition like 'consider' or 'regard'; it describes the status of those under the yoke as being slaves to their own masters.

The phrase 'πασης τιμης αξιους' (worthy of all honor) is partially omitted/compressed. The Vietnamese 'đáng trọng mọi vinh dự' translates to 'worthy of all honor', but it fails to capture the specific Greek structure where they are slaves *to* their masters [who are] worthy of all honor.
